caveats: The backlink list is Ahrefs page 1. A full sweep will add to the protect list.
Duplicate detection is slug similarity, a proxy. The real test is body-text hashing, which is what the SAP B1 audit used and what found 13 URLs sharing one article.
Re-measure once the untested pages have 90 days of history, then re-run this.
